title: Treatment of dehiscence-type defects with collagen matrix and/or enamel matrix derivative: Histomorphometric study in minipigs
authors: França-Grohmann IL, Sangiorgio JPM, Bueno MR, Casarin RCV, Silvério Ruiz KG, Nociti FH Jr, Casati MZ, Sallum EA. J Periodontol. 2020 Jul;91(7):967-974. doi: 10.1002/JPER.19-0107.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “(s): The results of the present study indicate that EMD application, irrespective of the combination with CM, may improve the periodontal regeneration of dehiscence-type defects in this animal model” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
